lines.text: Your tokenized stocks earn income.
Slowly, over months.
But what if you need cash today? Selling means giving up the asset.
So what if you could sell, just the income?
Meet Yieldex. A marketplace for time-limited income rights on tokenized stocks.
Alice locks her shares in a vault. She still owns them.
Then she sets her terms: half the income, for six months, at a fixed price of ninety U S D C.
Bob buys it. The payment and the right move in a single transaction. Both happen, or neither.
His six-month clock starts now.
When a dividend lands, the contract splits it by the agreed share.
Each side claims their part, in the asset token, whenever they like.
Want out early? Bob resells the whole right to Carol.
New owner. Same deadline. And what Bob already earned stays his.
Every share of income, accounted for.
Not sure what you're buying? Ask Yieldex AI.
It finds offers, explains the risks, and prepares a preview.
Your wallet always has the final say.
Because the price is fixed. The income isn't.
It could be higher.
Lower.
Or nothing at all.
Backing, rights and claims are enforced by smart contracts, live on Ethereum Sepolia.
Yieldex. Your shares stay yours. Your income has options.
